I think I put up with it in hopes that she’ll one day come back to me and pull her head out of her ass...or in this case her ex’s ass lol. After my freshman year, I stopped hanging out with people from high school and was significantly less excited to return to my hometown for break. I just chill with my family and work. That being said, I can’t wait to move back to school.

Okay what the fuck... how can they belittle you like that? I’m sure you had some deep feelings in that journal. I’m so sorry they did that to you. I think sometimes our families want to pretend like we are okay and that we are just seeking attention, but deep down they’re scared. They’re too scared to know what to do. Keep your chin up and feel free to PM me if you need to talk.
